title: NatureAnimals
description: Data file content/nature/animals.json (B4b K4, D711 §2, B2645): animals as a stock per species and biome - one number that grows towards a limit, no animal of its own, no killing (B2481). How full a stock is scales the growth groups of what the animals leave behind (egg, wool, feather, dung) in the nature takt. All numbers are placeholders (B2649).

id.description: Species id (internal; never shown, no animal is drawn).

groups.description: Growth groups of content/nature/settings.json whose factor this stock scales (stock / limit).

biomes.description: Biomes the species lives in (vocabulary biome); a biome the island does not have holds none.

cap_per_biome.description: Upper limit of the stock in each of its biomes on the island (animals).

start_permille.description: Stock of a new world as a share of the limit (permille).

growth_per_day_permille.description: Logistic growth per game day (permille of the stock, slowing towards the limit).

seasons.description: Growth factor per season (permille; a season not named grows at 1000): young in spring, little in winter.

AnimalSeasonFactor.description: Growth factor of a stock in one season (permille).
